bio: On a busy boulevard a stone's throw from the Église Saint-André d'Ornay, this attractive place is the stronghold of Welsh chef Nathan Cretney and his partner Solen Pineau. A palette of soft hues and bare stone walls contribute to the pleasant and bang-on-trend decor. As for the food, it reflects the quality of the region's splendid produce in a set menu (without options), composed according to what the market has to offer and tending towards the creative....
